method: 10% common-mode reduction in modeled delivered wind compensated MW-for-MW by additional HVO at 17 campus proxies, retaining original trades except for a mechanical 8-MW incremental-HVO cutback whenever archived base export exceeds 2990 MW; includes archived ex-post preventive reserve, with 13% hypothetical collector ratings; full 94-state nonlinear AC replay; neither dispatch optimization nor physical validation
notes: Ex-post dispatch uses archived base-wind worst-case reserve PLUS a conservative 10%-wind HVO substitution, with up to 8MW reduction during historical high-export hours; annual HVO caps and per-hour generator headroom checked; no storage/commitment optimization or real-time control.
All 37 buses, 93 parallel circuits, 17 campus allocation and 931 MVAr idealized Q correction are hypothetical.
The AC grid slack is independently checked against external access caps; these have not been contracted.
No PV bus generator Q limits, load-dependent losses feedback, tap controls, harmonics, fault duty or dynamic protections.
